name: Illegal Bikes
desc:
🏍️ BIKES, BUT WITH GUNS.

Welcome to Illegal Bikes! Ride bikes off huge motocross jumps, land backflips for cash, and shoot other riders off their bikes in mid-air.

🔫 Unlock guns from pistols to a minigun & black hole launcher
🤸 Crash hard and go RAGDOLLING down the hill
🔥 Collect bikes from dirt bikes to street bikes, a dragon bike & an angel bike
📦 Open crates for rare items, all the way up to GODLY
💰 Earn cash for flips, 360s, kills & distance
🚀 Fly, glide, triple jump & warp boost
🎬 Instant replays of your best tricks, kills & crashes
👥 Ride with friends for bonus cash
🎮 PC, Mobile, Tablet & Controller

Thanks for riding. See you on the track 🏁

llm.loop: ride bikes off motocross jumps -> land flips for cash and shoot riders off their bikes -> open crates for bikes/guns -> collect rarer ones
llm.objectives: earn cash from tricks and kills, collect godly bikes and guns
llm.progression: cash, crate rarity, bike and gun collection
unique: bikes with guns mid-air combat plus ragdoll physics
llm.thumbnails: mid-air bikers firing guns over a blue sky and hills
llm.complexity_notes: vehicle physics, ragdoll, weapons, map jumps; moderate
